players.product: MBE-grown InP PIN / APD photodetector epiwafers for 100G-200G data-center optical transceivers, plus GaAs VCSEL / pHEMT and InP HBT epiwafers

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 consolidated revenue was NTD 1,079,340 thousand, up 50.49% from NTD 717,235 thousand in 2024; after-tax net profit NTD 65,287 thousand (2024: net loss NTD 131,776 thousand); EPS NTD 1.65; gross margin 36% versus 16% in 2024. Growth was mainly driven by a surge in demand for InP epitaxial wafers plus higher sales of hardware components and MBE systems.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue NTD 1,079,340 thousand (+50.49%); net profit NTD 65,287 thousand; EPS NTD 1.65; gross margin 36% (2024: 16%)

quarterly_data.signal: Letter to shareholders: AI data-center expansion and high-performance computing drove a surge in demand for InP PIN epiwafers, but it also caused an InP substrate shortage, and U.S.-China trade tensions constrained global supply by classifying InP substrates as export-controlled items, which affected the company's production and shipments. InP epiwafers were NTD 534,899 thousand, 49.56% of 2025 revenue (2024: 37.81%); consigned substrates from certain major customers helped gross margin.
quarterly_data.figure: InP epiwafers NTD 534,899 thousand, 49.56% of 2025 revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Company claim: IntelliEPI is the world's top InP PIN supplier, accounting for almost 100% of 100G-200G InP PIN commercial orders worldwide, and supplies three of the world's top four optoelectronic companies; its chart of the commercial 200G InP PIN market shows IntelliEPI at 60%.
quarterly_data.figure: almost 100% of 100G-200G InP PIN commercial orders; 60% of commercial 200G InP PIN (company chart)

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: only E company exceeded 10% of 2025 sales, at NTD 282,916 thousand (26%); it is a long-term key customer buying mainly InP PIN wafers used in optical transceiver modules for large-scale data centers, and its procurement is accelerating with AI data-center expansion, though the global InP substrate shortage affects revenue growth. In Q1 2026 E company was 30.73% of sales (NTD 102,070 thousand) and T company 15.66% (NTD 52,031 thousand). The company expects E company to remain a top customer.
quarterly_data.figure: E company NTD 282,916 thousand, 26% of 2025 sales; Q1 2026: E company 30.73%, T company 15.66%

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier concentration: Sumitomo Semiconductor (a Sumitomo Group semiconductor materials supplier) supplied mainly InP substrates and was 45.27% of 2025 purchases (NTD 121,234 thousand), with procurement from Sumitomo up 47.01% while InP product sales rose 97.23%; Freiberger, the main GaAs substrate supplier, was 16.99% (NTD 45,495 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: Sumitomo Semiconductor NTD 121,234 thousand (45.27% of purchases); Freiberger NTD 45,495 thousand (16.99%)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment was NTD 260,754 thousand for ongoing capacity expansion. 2026 plan: expand capacity and obtain additional substrate allocations to meet customer delivery schedules for volume-production orders of InP PIN wafers for AI data centers, proceed with Phase II expansion of the new plant, and finalize the U.S. federal CHIPS Act subsidy contract, expected to be signed in 2026. Management expects revenue and profitability to reach new record highs.
Q1 2026 revenue was NTD 332,151 thousand, with InP epiwafers NTD 181,105 thousand (54.52%) and GaAs epiwafers NTD 45,809 thousand (13.79%).
In December 2025 the board approved a share exchange with EZconn Corporation (Code 6442) to enter a long-term strategic partnership; 2026/5/5 was set as the share exchange record date.

IntelliEPI.why: MBE epitaxy foundry whose InP PIN photodetector epiwafers go into optical transceiver modules for AI data centers; InP epiwafers were 49.56% of 2025 revenue and drove 50.49% revenue growth.

IET supplies products to three of the world's top four optoelctronic companies'; top customer E company buys 'InP PIN wafers used in optical transceiver module for large-scale data center'.
